newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore September CPI rises 1.5 pct on year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore September CPI rises 1.5 pct on year.

text.p: Singapore's consumer price index (CPI) of inflation was up 1.5 percent from a year earlier in September, state television said on Wednesday.
The CPI figure was in line with market expectations.
A Reuters poll of 12 economists on October 17 forecast the CPI would rise by 1.5 percent year on year in September.
State television gave no figure for the month-on-month change in the CPI or a breakdown by category.
